details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{peq}}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: Repeatedly propose any remaining candidate as a proper equivalence-query hypothesis. A negative answer supplies a counterexample and in particular eliminates the proposed candidate; after at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ negative answers, the unique remaining concept is the target.
name: Size / Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity
